title: The kiln
logline: The dry kiln's doors open on stacked cedar, steam coming off the boards into February air, a man in the doorway from behind. The smell the strip couldn't draw; the page draws the steam.

panels.composition: The open doors of a lumber dry kiln with stacked cedar inside steaming into cold air, a man in the doorway from behind, the yard beyond, black spotting in the kiln's dark.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, the open doors of a lumber dry kiln with stacked cedar inside steaming into cold air and a man in the doorway seen from behind, a mill yard beyond, no words
